summary.text: Brenda Sanders, a Green Party candidate and Detroit attorney, lost the November 3, 2026 election for U.S. House in Michigan's 12th District to Rashida Tlaib.
She served as a judge of the 36th District Court and was the Green Party nominee in this district in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Sanders earned an undergraduate degree from the University of Michigan in 1980 and a J.D. from the University of Detroit Mercy School of Law in 1983.
She practiced law in Detroit for 24 years, specializing in criminal, family, civil litigation and church law, and served as house counsel for the 36th District Court.
She later became a judge of the Michigan 36th District Court and ran for re-election unopposed in 2014.
Sanders ran as the Green Party candidate for this district in 2024, receiving 2.3% of the vote, and was nominated again at the Green Party convention on July 18, 2026.
She received 1.0% of the vote to Rashida Tlaib's 76.0%, according to unofficial results reported by NBC News.
